verdict.rationale: The firm has a dedicated Executive Compensation practice page citing Section 409A and 280G work. That is adjacent to equity compensation, but the page never explicitly describes designing employee option plans. The Clerky partnership covers only founder stock issuances, founder vesting and 83(b) elections, not employee equity programs. Missing for 10: explicit description of employee stock option or equity incentive plan design, any coverage of local schemes (UK EMI, German VSOP/ESOP, Indian ESOP), international equity plan capability (all listed offices are U.S.), and independent corroboration.
